Original SVG-use character-limit controls generated by
`tools/svg_use_large_text_fixture.py` from our own SVG picture package.
No corpus content or font programs are included.

The long source has 120,008 characters in one text node; ordinary whitespace
collapses to `Large SVG`. The compact control uses one space. Conservative
source-plus-instance accounting visits 240,016 characters in the long control.
The package places the SVG in ordinary, cropped, grouped and shape-fill pictures.

The reference application opened exact hash-verified copies via Open-OfficeDocument.ps1.
`tools/capture_open_picture_metafile.ps1` read the first inline picture without
saving or changing either document. `tools/extract_svg_viewport_metafiles.py`
extracted the nested native metafiles. Both are byte-identical: see
`reference.json`. This establishes whitespace equivalence in the reference application; it does
not assert glyph-by-glyph browser/native raster equivalence or performance at five million
visible characters.
